@variant dark includes @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) arm; isDark computed references window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
ThemeToggleComponent with SVG icons; ThemeService.toggle() cycles system->dark->light->system
signal<ThemePreference>('system') with .asReadonly() and computed() for isDark
